title: payments.payment.finalized (schema_version 1)
description: Published via the outbox when a matched payment reaches chain finality (R10). Correlates by paymentUuid (or chain + txHash); deliberately carries no invoiceUuid. Partition key = paymentUuid.

fromAddress.description: Sender address; null when chain.tx.finalized did not carry one.

toAddress.description: Recipient address; null when chain.tx.finalized did not carry one.

amount.description: Observed amount as a whole number of token base units, as a decimal string (never a JSON number).
